# Dynamic declarations under Bzlmod (design 2.7: a lock label must be one
# plain string naming a file of the main repository). A computed lock label,
# a hub name from a function and a `use_extension` whose label is computed:
# none can be followed, so the model is incomplete and each ecosystem that
# could be meant is undetermined.

=== .bazelversion
9.3.2
=== MODULE.bazel
module(name = "app")

bazel_dep(name = "aspect_rules_js", version = "3.6.0")
bazel_dep(name = "rules_jvm_external", version = "7.2")

LOCKS = {"web": "//web:pnpm-lock.yaml"}

npm = use_extension("@aspect_rules_js//npm:extensions.bzl", "npm")
npm.npm_translate_lock(
    name = "npm",
    pnpm_lock = LOCKS["web"],
)
use_repo(npm, "npm")

maven = use_extension("@rules_jvm_external//:extensions.bzl", "maven")
maven.install(
    name = hub_name("main"),
    artifacts = ["junit:junit:4.13.2"],
    lock_file = "//:maven_install.json",
)
use_repo(maven, "maven_main")
=== web/pnpm-lock.yaml
lockfileVersion: '9.0'
=== maven_install.json
{"version": "2", "artifacts": {}}
